We embarked on a journey to fix the broken Islamic banking for good. Our aim? Transparency, modern technology, and fair values. All without the need for physical human interaction, with a goal to be the first Islamic Super-App.

We started off by committing to no hidden fees, interest, or late penalty fees. Our obsession is people. We are tackling the complex problem most people have; Money. We do not want to throw solutions around, in the hope they find a problem to solve. That's why we kicked off with Beta. Meaning, fixing problems without you telling us to do so.

With Mizan Pay-later; our first product ship, will commit to no hidden fees, interest, or tricks. That’s our commitment, a movement where people speak your language, understand your hopes, and help you reach your financial goals.

Our team is small which makes us agile. We're misfits that got together to find elegant solutions to complex problems. But above all, just like you, we are empathetic believers of simplicity, honesty, and no tricks.

It’s a disruptive journey, but our promise is to stay woke, proactively engaging with our customers and finding innovative ways for financial inclusion.

It’s time, time to dip our toes in the water.

properties.description:
Syka is on a mission to level the global playing field for African entrepreneurs. We're building payment infrastructure that eliminates the "geography tax", the systematic barriers that prevent African businesses from competing globally.

The Problem We Solve
Right now, 200 million African entrepreneurs face discrimination in global payment systems. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, excluding 76% of the world. PayPal restricts withdrawals in most African markets. Traditional bank transfers incur fees of 8-15% and take up to 7 days to settle. This isn't a technology problem; it's discrimination based on geography.

Our Solution
Syka provides African businesses with the same payment infrastructure available in San Francisco or London:
1. Collect payments globally via payment links, invoicing, and APIs
2. Send payments instantly to suppliers, teams, and vendors worldwide
3. Store value safely in USDT/USDC to protect against currency volatility
4. Manage multi-currency treasury with real-time visibility and forecasting

All at 0.75% transaction fees with instant settlement, no geographic restrictions, no hidden charges, no arbitrary account freezes.

Who We Are:
We exist to shape the future of finance and redefine its core. At SEBx, innovation isn’t just a process, it’s a mindset. Our Innovation Ecosystem spans three core pillars: Business, Research, and Technology, powered by a world-class network of startups, leading tech firms, top universities, and industry partners. Leveraging expertise from SEB and our partners, we take a portfolio approach across diverse business and technology domains, ensuring agility and impact.

Our team combines PhD-level AI specialists with seasoned professionals, bringing over a century of combined experience in banking and startups. This unique blend equips us to explore, test, and implement innovative concepts swiftly and effectively. With a long-term vision spanning 5 to 15 years, SEBx is committed to future-proofing finance and continuously pushing boundaries to keep SEB at the cutting edge of the industry.

SEBx is proud to be part of the SEB Group

Our History:
SEBx was born from a bold idea: to keep the bank relevant in a rapidly changing world and to embrace disruption rather than fear it.

In 2018, SEB’s CEO and a visionary team created a small and agile unit, the “X division” with a mandate to operate beyond conventional structures and legacy processes, while having full access to the bank’s resources. This freedom allowed us to chart our own course, explore emerging technologies, and pioneer groundbreaking innovations.

2018 – SEBx Innovation Studio launched.
2022 – Our first external customer joined, and SEB Embedded was born.
2023 – SEBx evolved into SEBx 2.0 with a new team on place, reaffirming our mission to lead the way into the future.

properties.name: Audi Revolut F1 Team
properties.description: Audi Revolut F1 Team is the official factory team of Audi, as the brand enters the FIA Formula 1 World Championship for the first time in 2026. This project, in which Audi will create its own hybrid drive system ('power unit') developed in Germany, represents the ultimate expression of the manufacturer's 'Vorsprung durch Technik' philosophy and embodies a long-term commitment to compete at the pinnacle of motorsport with the clear objective of challenging for world championships by 2030. Audi Revolut F1 Team is based in three locations: the power unit is developed by Audi Formula Racing GmbH at the Audi Competence Center Motorsport in Neuburg, Germany; the chassis is engineered and race operations are managed from the state-of-the-art facilities of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil, Switzerland; while the Audi Motorsport Technology Centre UK in Bicester, United Kingdom, provides a foothold in the heart of 'Motorsport Valley', with direct access to top F1 talent and key strategic partners. This integrated structure provides complete control over the project, embedding a culture of precision, innovation, and relentless performance. Audi's entry is strategically timed to coincide with new Formula 1 regulations focused on increased electrification, as the electric share of the hybrid drive is raised to almost 50%, and the introduction of 100% sustainable fuels. The entry into Formula 1, one of the most important platforms in the world, serves as a high-tech catalyst for the entire Audi brand, acting as a global stage to demonstrate technological leadership and connect with new, diverse audiences by creating cultural impact that resonates far beyond the race track.

With Mizan Pay-later; our first product ship, will commit to no hidden fees, interest, or tricks. That’s our commitment, a movement where people speak your language, understand your hopes, and help you reach your financial goals.

Our team is small which makes us agile. We're misfits that got together to find elegant solutions to complex problems. But above all, just like you, we are empathetic believers of simplicity, honesty, and no tricks.

It’s a disruptive journey, but our promise is to stay woke, proactively engaging with our customers and finding innovative ways for financial inclusion.

It’s time, time to dip our toes in the water.

entity.name: Revolut
entity.description: Revolut Group Holdings Ltd, known as Revolut, is a British global financial technology company headquartered in London and founded in July 2015 by Nik Storonskiy and Vlad Yatsenko. As of March 2026, Revolut has over 70 million customers and supports transfers across more than 160 countries and regions. It was valued at $75 billion in November 2025. The bank offers free and subscription-based digital banking services, primarily through a mobile app. Banking services include bank accounts, debit cards, credit cards, currency exchange with over 25 fiat currencies, stock trading, cryptocurrency exchange and peer-to-peer payments. For companies, the Revolut Business platform provides multi-currency corporate accounts, payroll processing, and integration with accounting software. Revolut's mobile app supports spending and ATM withdrawals in 120 currencies and transfers in 36 currencies. Revolut's credit card is available in Poland, Lithuania, the United States, and Ireland.

Cross-border payments: real-time settlement across 30+ corridors, ~20% lower total cost, and upfront FX locking without legacy intermediaries.
Agentic payments: programmable wallets and machine-native rails so AI agents can transact autonomously within set compliance boundaries.
We are continuously expanding the stack for programmable B2B flows, including recurring settlement, payment-linked FX forwards, and on-chain BNPL.

Backed by IFB Hamburg, Gnosis, and Heartfelt Capital (Axel Springer).
Offices in Hamburg, Riga & Berlin.

entity.name: SEBx
entity.description:
Who We Are:
We exist to shape the future of finance and redefine its core. At SEBx, innovation isn’t just a process, it’s a mindset. Our Innovation Ecosystem spans three core pillars: Business, Research, and Technology, powered by a world-class network of startups, leading tech firms, top universities, and industry partners. Together, we create forward-thinking solutions and groundbreaking research.

SEBx thrives on curiosity and exploration. We don’t just monitor trends, we venture into the unknown, experiment boldly, and rapidly prototype ideas that challenge the status quo. Leveraging expertise from SEB and our partners, we take a portfolio approach across diverse business and technology domains, ensuring agility and impact.

Our team combines PhD-level AI specialists with seasoned professionals, bringing over a century of combined experience in banking and startups. This unique blend equips us to explore, test, and implement innovative concepts swiftly and effectively. With a long-term vision spanning 5 to 15 years, SEBx is committed to future-proofing finance and continuously pushing boundaries to keep SEB at the cutting edge of the industry.

SEBx is proud to be part of the SEB Group

Our History:
SEBx was born from a bold idea: to keep the bank relevant in a rapidly changing world and to embrace disruption rather than fear it.

In 2018, SEB’s CEO and a visionary team created a small and agile unit, the “X division” with a mandate to operate beyond conventional structures and legacy processes, while having full access to the bank’s resources. This freedom allowed us to chart our own course, explore emerging technologies, and pioneer groundbreaking innovations.

2018 – SEBx Innovation Studio launched.
2022 – Our first external customer joined, and SEB Embedded was born.
2023 – SEBx evolved into SEBx 2.0 with a new team on place, reaffirming our mission to lead the way into the future.

entity.name: Audi Revolut F1 Team
entity.description: Audi Revolut F1 Team is the official factory team of Audi, as the brand enters the FIA Formula 1 World Championship for the first time in 2026. This project, in which Audi will create its own hybrid drive system ('power unit') developed in Germany, represents the ultimate expression of the manufacturer's 'Vorsprung durch Technik' philosophy and embodies a long-term commitment to compete at the pinnacle of motorsport with the clear objective of challenging for world championships by 2030. Audi Revolut F1 Team is based in three locations: the power unit is developed by Audi Formula Racing GmbH at the Audi Competence Center Motorsport in Neuburg, Germany; the chassis is engineered and race operations are managed from the state-of-the-art facilities of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil, Switzerland; while the Audi Motorsport Technology Centre UK in Bicester, United Kingdom, provides a foothold in the heart of 'Motorsport Valley', with direct access to top F1 talent and key strategic partners. This integrated structure provides complete control over the project, embedding a culture of precision, innovation, and relentless performance. Audi's entry is strategically timed to coincide with new Formula 1 regulations focused on increased electrification, as the electric share of the hybrid drive is raised to almost 50%, and the introduction of 100% sustainable fuels. The entry into Formula 1, one of the most important platforms in the world, serves as a high-tech catalyst for the entire Audi brand, acting as a global stage to demonstrate technological leadership and connect with new, diverse audiences by creating cultural impact that resonates far beyond the race track.

entity.name: Xist4
entity.description:
Xist4 is a specialist data, technology and leadership recruitment agency based in Bristol and London.

We work with a focused range of organisations where our sector knowledge makes a real difference. In Fintech, we partner with Paytech and Regtech businesses building payment systems, fraud platforms and regulatory technology. In Greentech, we work with companies developing EV charging networks, fleet electrification and smart energy infrastructure. We also support Arts, Cultural and Heritage institutions strengthening their digital capability and ambitious technology startups and scale-ups building their core teams.

We recruit across:

	•	Data Science, AI and Machine Learning
	•	Data Engineering and Architecture
	•	Business Intelligence and Insights
	•	Software Engineering
	•	Cloud and Infrastructure
	•	Cyber Security
	•	Technology and Data Leadership

We work with a small number of clients at a time. That is a deliberate choice. It means every brief gets proper attention, every candidate is treated properly and every search is run with the care that business critical roles actually deserve.

95% of the professionals we place remain in role after twelve months. We think that says more about how we work than any claim we could make about ourselves.

If you are hiring for a role that matters, we would be glad to hear from you.
